params_source: results/calibration.json: calibrated parameters not adopted, defaults used
edge_depth: street water depth on a segment = the larger of its two end-junction street depths
keys: prob_pct['<storm mm>|<threshold cm>'][frame][edge] = percent of members with depth over the threshold at that frame; prob_any_pct['<storm mm>|<threshold cm>'][edge] = percent of members whose peak depth over the whole run exceeds it
note: Synthetic ensemble standing in for pySTEPS radar ensembles. Each of the 30 members is the same synthetic, spatially uniform, bell-shaped storm as scenarios.json with its total scaled by a lognormal factor (median 1, sigma 0.25 in natural log) and its peak time shifted uniformly within plus or minus 20 minutes, seed 2026. The same 30 draws are used for every storm size. Clean drains only. Probabilities are counts over members, so they carry the model's own limits: 1D streets, uncalibrated hydraulics, no canal or river backwater.
